description: A physical model that treats the input as a driven radius and runs it through a gravity and uncertainty calculation against an internal oscillator

params.text: Sets the frequency of the internal mass oscillator, four octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Sets the level at which the mass oscillator is turned inside out to keep the model stable, 0.5V at fully counter-clockwise to 1V fully clockwise
Multiplies the uncertainty term, twice at fully counter-clockwise to four times fully clockwise
Multiplies the gravity term, once at fully counter-clockwise to four times fully clockwise
Multiplies the containment term, four times at fully counter-clockwise to sixteen times fully clockwise
Stretches the input radius by the mass oscillator, half at fully counter-clockwise to twice fully clockwise

inputs.text: The signal treated as the driven radius
Moves the mass oscillator one octave per volt on top of the OM knob
Moves the stability level on top of the SING knob, a tenth of a doubling per volt
Moves the uncertainty multiplier on top of the PLK knob, a tenth of a doubling per volt
Moves the gravity multiplier on top of the NTN knob, a tenth of a doubling per volt
Moves the containment multiplier on top of the MASS knob, a tenth of a doubling per volt
Moves the radius stretch on top of the ANG knob, a full doubling per volt

outputs.text: The uncertainty, gravity and containment terms added together and halved

notes: the mass oscillator runs whatever is patched, so the module makes sound on its own; the input adds the gravity and containment terms on top of it
the mass knob is configured with a default outside its own range, so where it stands on a new module is decided by Rack rather than by the module
